description: Search stored events by words. Use it for "what happened with Claude Code this week?", "any news about Gemini CLI?", "Codex releases". Pass q, words that must all appear in an event's title or summary. Optional: hours to look back (default 168, at most 720), limit (default 10, at most 25). Returns matching events ranked by score and heat, each with a summary, heat and source links, and the total number of matches.

hours.description: Look back this many hours (default 168, at most 720)

niche.description: The topic area to read. Only "ai-coding-agents" (AI coding agents) exists today, and it is the default.

q.description: Words to look for in event titles and summaries, such as "claude code release". Every word must appear.

name: search_events

asOf.description: When the sources were last read completely

heat.description: Independent sources that reported the event within 48 hours of its first report

total.description: Matching events before the limit was applied

title: Search AI coding agent events
